name: fitcoach
description: FitCoach: a full-stack personal training and nutrition tracker with a rule-based (optionally AI-assisted) coach. MERN stack.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run demo -w server
